user.title: Add a Wake-on-LAN device
user.description: Each entry creates one switch that wakes the device and tracks whether it is awake.

data.name: Device name
data.host: IP address or hostname (used for liveness checks)
data.broadcast_address: Broadcast address (leave empty to auto-derive from host)
data.turn_off_script: Shutdown script (optional, runs when the switch is turned off)

error.invalid_mac: Invalid MAC address (use e.g. AA:BB:CC:DD:EE:FF or AA-BB-CC-DD-EE-FF).
error.invalid_host: Could not resolve the IP address or hostname.

abort.already_configured: A device with this MAC address already exists.

data.host: IP address or hostname (used for liveness checks)

data.turn_off_script: Shutdown script (optional, runs when the switch is turned off)

send_magic_packet.name: Send magic packet
send_magic_packet.description: Sends a Wake-on-LAN magic packet to wake a device.

mac.name: MAC address
mac.description: The MAC address of the device to wake.

broadcast_address.name: Broadcast address
broadcast_address.description: Broadcast address to send the packet to. Defaults to 255.255.255.255.

broadcast_port.name: Broadcast port
broadcast_port.description: UDP port to send the packet to. Defaults to 9.
